day_shape: 62 items dominated by US naval blockade of Iranian ports (CENTCOM cites 48 vessels redirected in 20 days), Trump warning of renewed strikes, Iran International reporting Iran cutting oil output, and heavy regime-channel Workers'/Teachers' Day messaging from Khamenei's office.

threads.label: US blockade and Iran oil exports
threads.summary: CENTCOM said 48 vessels had been redirected over 20 days under the US blockade of Iranian ports, with USS New Orleans operating in the Arabian Sea. Iran International, citing Bloomberg, reported Iran curbing oil production as storage fills, while Defa Press claimed a 1.9-million-barrel tanker had broken through the blockade.

threads.label: Trump-Iran negotiation standoff
threads.summary: Trump said he could renew strikes on Iran 'if they misbehave' and was reviewing the 'concept of the deal', while a senior Iranian officer warned renewed war with the US was 'likely'. Defa Press claimed America's decision-making space had narrowed to 'an impossible operation or a bad deal'.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz toll plan
threads.summary: Iran International reported Iranian lawmakers proposing to bar Israeli vessels permanently from the Strait of Hormuz and require US and allied ships to pay war reparations to transit. IRIB cited the parliament vice-speaker saying the strait would not return to pre-war conditions.

threads.label: Hezbollah-IDF exchanges in south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said it eliminated two armed Hezbollah operatives south of the Forward Defense Line and struck a loaded launcher, while Hezbollah fired rockets at troops with no injuries reported. Defa Press claimed Hezbollah was using fibre-optic drones against Merkava tanks, and an MP called resistance Lebanon's 'national choice'.

threads.label: Iranian executions and detentions
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post and Iran International reported Iran executing a man over a security officer's killing and political prisoner Mehrab Abdollahzadeh in Urmia. The Jerusalem Post also reported Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi in critical condition after a heart attack in prison.

threads.label: Khamenei Workers' and Teachers' Day cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted a Workers' and Teachers' Day message urging employers to avoid layoffs and a separate Persian Gulf Day message, alongside an audio recitation. Defa Press and IRIB amplified related teacher-themed content.

threads.label: Regime anti-US framing and claims
threads.summary: Mohsen Rezaei told America to 'prepare for a graveyard of your forces', and Defa Press and IRIB amplified claims of US imperial decline, citing CNN on base repair costs and a New York Times piece. IRIB said over 55,000 lawsuits had been filed against the US and Israel over the Minab school strike.

events.title_en: Google and Pentagon; an alliance with artificial intelligence for war crimes
events.summary_en: Google and Pentagon; an alliance with artificial intelligence for war crimes. The Pentagon has signed a contract with Google to deploy and use artificial intelligence in the US military at a time when Iran's armed forces, in the forty-day war, destroyed part of the enemy's artificial intelligence infrastructure in countries bordering the Persian Gulf. Google signed a confidential contract with the US Department of Defence this month that allows the Pentagon to use Google's advanced artificial intelligence models, including Gemini, for any lawful government purpose. This agreement places Google alongside other technology giants such as OpenAI and Grok that previously signed similar contracts with the US government.

events.title_en: MS Now network: trust of young Americans in government has fallen to 15 per cent, the lowest level in history
events.summary_en: MS Now network: trust of young Americans in government has fallen to 15 per cent, the lowest level in history. Only around 15 per cent of young people said they trust the federal government. This sharp decline in confidence is accompanied by widespread feelings of powerlessness, with half of respondents saying that people like them have no role in government decisions. This pessimism has formed amid economic pressures such as inflation and cost of living increases, whilst at the same time concerns about the Iran war and America's role in it have risen. Data shows that young Americans have more doubts than ever before about the country's future and the performance of political institutions, and trust in structures...

events.title_en: New York Times account of the decline of American empire
events.summary_en: The New York Times writes: The attack by America and Israel on Iran was more than a bad idea; this attack has become a turning point in the decline of the American empire. Imperial systems only last as long as their instruments are sufficient for their objectives, but the Iran war dangerously reveals a mismatch between objectives and reality. According to this report, internal problems and experiences of failure in Iraq and Afghanistan have now spread to the Iran war, plunging America into a major crisis that can only result in decline for America.

events.title_en: A giant Iranian oil tanker breaks through American blockade. Tank Trackers: The super tanker HUGE carrying more than 1.9 million barrels of crude oil, valued at approximately 220 million dollars, has managed to break through the blockade of the American terrorist military and reach the Far East region. This tanker was sighted off the coast of Sri Lanka more than a week ago. The vessel is now passing through the Lombok Strait in Indonesia towards the Riau Islands.

events.title_en: The most effective link in the cultural struggle. An overview of the unparalleled position and the special role and duty of teachers based on the message of His Eminence Seyyed Majataba Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Revolution. Key functions of the teacher: serious responsibility for teaching knowledge; fostering insight and shaping the identity of the future generation; developing skills; delineating Iranian Islamic identity and its increasing entrenchment in minds. Importance of teachers and teaching: the most effective link in the cultural struggle; the backbone of the cultural arena; students and scholars represent the conduct and words of their teachers. Recommendation to teachers: awareness of the importance of their special position beyond a profession. Taken from the message of 11 Ordibehesht 1405.
